stories.title: Russia says it hit military factories across Ukraine in overnight strike
stories.summary: Russia's military said it carried out a massive overnight strike on military factories across Ukraine, including in Kyiv, as Moscow and Kyiv exchanged attacks on each other's capitals. The strikes came as US envoys arrived in Moscow for peace talks.

stories.title: Putin agrees to let Europeans join next round of Ukraine peace talks
stories.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff said Vladimir Putin agreed that European representatives will join the next round of trilateral talks, calling it an important moment. The Kremlin said the Witkoff-Kushner meeting was useful and that Putin will discuss Ukraine with Trump at an APEC summit this month.

stories.title: Zelensky joins 40+ European leaders in Dublin, warns on US-Russia security framework
stories.summary: At the European Political Community summit in Dublin, Zelensky urged leaders to scrutinise what he called 'strange' attempts to agree a new Europe-Russia security framework. He also said restrictions on the Starshield satellite service are slowing Ukrainian interceptors.

stories.title: Former Italian Red Brigades member escapes house arrest in Argentina
stories.summary: A former member of Italy's Red Brigades has escaped from house arrest in Argentina, according to Al Jazeera.

stories.title: Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Huang's exit
stories.summary: Clément Delangue called Jensen Huang's departure a 'really sad day' and pledged to keep pushing open-source AI, raising questions about Nvidia's pending $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. Huang had been the industry's most visible open-model advocate.

stories.title: Nvidia on track to shed more than $700 billion in market value after Huang resigns
stories.summary: Nvidia shares fell again on Thursday, putting the chipmaker on course to lose over $700 billion in value since the prior US close. The selloff reflects investor anxiety about leadership at the centre of the AI buildout.

stories.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
stories.summary: Nvidia's board announced Huang resigned effective immediately after an investigation into an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim CEO. The exit removes the executive most associated with the AI boom he helped build.

stories.title: Browns plan Salute to Service tributes for Sunday's Texans game
stories.summary: Cleveland will mark its annual Salute to Service game against Houston with a Navy color guard, a T-6 flyover, an Honor Row for all six branches and an Army-Navy halftime skills challenge. Assistant team physician Dr. Benjamin Boswell, an Army Reserve officer, is the club's award nominee.

stories.title: Isaiah Bond's role in Cleveland is shrinking fast
stories.summary: The second-year receiver, viewed as a promising piece entering 2026, is barely seeing the field as the Browns' passing game leans on other targets. His fade raises questions about his future in a receiver room already reshaped by injuries.

stories.title: Denzel Boston misses Thursday's practice; Elgton Jenkins returns
stories.summary: Rookie receiver Denzel Boston sat out again with a toe injury, leaving KC Concepcion in line for more targets against Houston. Center Elgton Jenkins was back at practice, but safety Ronnie Hickman (concussion) and fullback Michael Burton (calf) remained sidelined.

stories.title: Day confronts first regular-season losing streak, sticks with Luke Fahey at QB
stories.summary: Ryan Day acknowledged anger and frustration inside the Woody Hayes Athletic Center as Ohio State prepares for Northwestern after back-to-back double-digit losses. The AP reported Day is keeping freshman Luke Fahey as the starter rather than turning to Tavien St. Clair.

stories.title: Day: Buckeyes focused on winning final three games, starting with Northwestern
stories.summary: On his weekly radio show, Day said Ohio State is focused on beating Northwestern, Nebraska and Michigan before thinking about the postseason, while conceding the pass rush and missed interception chances must improve. Safety Earl Little Jr. said communication on defense is the priority against Chip Kelly's offense.

stories.title: Buckeyes land four-star RB Daylon Gordon for 2027 class
stories.summary: Ohio State ended a long, bumpy search for a running back in the 2027 cycle by landing four-star Daylon Gordon. The commitment fills the biggest remaining hole in the class as the staff juggles late-season on-field problems with recruiting.

stories.title: Wolff: Antonelli is no Senna yet, but may be a 'Senninha'
stories.summary: Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff tempered comparisons between newly crowned champion Kimi Antonelli and Ayrton Senna, suggesting the 20-year-old is more of a 'Senninha' for now. Antonelli became F1's youngest world champion in Mexico City earlier this month.

stories.title: Racing Bulls confirm unchanged Lawson-Lindblad line-up for 2027
stories.summary: Racing Bulls ended months of speculation by extending both Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad for 2027, leaving Red Bull junior Nikola Tsolov without a seat. The team opted for continuity in year two of the current regulations.

stories.title: FIA publishes latest ADUO results in final 2026 season review
stories.summary: The FIA released its latest additional development and upgrade opportunity (ADUO) findings as part of a final review of the 2026 power-unit landscape. The results determine how much extra engine development each manufacturer is allowed.

stories.title: Honda at a loss to explain Lance Stroll's 13th DNF of the season
stories.summary: Honda said it is still working to pinpoint the cause of Lance Stroll's latest retirement, his 13th of the 2026 campaign. The repeated failures have wrecked Aston Martin's constructors' points haul in the final season of the current engine rules.

stories.title: Columbus maps out years-long rollout of Issues 8 and 9
stories.summary: Council is moving quickly to seat an independent redistricting commission after voters approved ward-style representation, with applications possibly opening within a month. The expanded 13-member council phases in through 2027 and 2029 elections.

stories.title: New Albany pastor's son found guilty on all 27 sexual assault charges
stories.summary: A Knox County case ended with guilty verdicts on every count against the son of a New Albany pastor, NBC4 reported. The verdict closes a case that drew statewide attention.

stories.title: Acton outlines response to 2027 federal Medicaid changes
stories.summary: Ohio's incoming governor, Amy Acton, is sketching out how her administration will handle federal Medicaid changes set to take effect in 2027. The planning comes as she also faces questions about her refusal to speak with opponent Vivek Ramaswamy.

stories.title: Teen killed after vehicle hits tree, catches fire in Delaware County
stories.summary: A teenager died after the vehicle they were in left the road, struck a tree and caught fire in Delaware County, according to NBC4.
